narration: Local Kokoro ONNX af_heart, American English; new first-purchase narration with measured optional caption cues.
sources: Real application recordings of one fictional restaurant and its first purchase, with the earlier licensed kitchen opening and closing restored. Native 3840×2400 application footage; kitchen-source details are recorded in brandSources. Public signup shows approved-pilot Google entry; authentication is completed off camera in an isolated local environment. No internal demo promotion or production writes. Actions may be condensed up to 1.5x; recordings do not promise loading speed.

scenes.title: Every service starts with a purchase
phrases: QuotePlate connects your kitchen, purchasing decisions and suppliers.

scenes.title: Add your restaurant
phrases: Start with your restaurant’s name, phone and address.
Add your city, state and PIN code for deliveries.

scenes.title: Open your workspace
phrases: Enter the owner’s name and work email.
For approved pilot owners, continue with Google to create the workspace and open Today.

scenes.title: Approve your first menu
phrases: Type or paste dishes, upload photos, or take a menu photo on your phone.
Or use a permitted website link.
Here, we type tomato curry, then review the ingredients, quantity and unit.
Approve your menu before making a purchase.

scenes.title: Add your suppliers
phrases: Open Suppliers and add the businesses you buy from.
Enter their names and ingredient categories.
We add two example suppliers to compare their replies.
scenes.text: Open Suppliers and add the businesses you buy from. Enter their names and ingredient categories. We add two example suppliers to compare their replies.

scenes.title: Create the first request
phrases: Choose New purchase. Give it a name and select the approved menu.
Check quantities. We need ten kilos of tomatoes.
Set the delivery date and reply deadline.
Choose your suppliers, save the draft, then open it for quotes.
scenes.text: Choose New purchase. Give it a name and select the approved menu. Check quantities. We need ten kilos of tomatoes. Set the delivery date and reply deadline. Choose your suppliers, save the draft, then open it for quotes.

scenes.title: Quote from your phone
phrases: Suppliers can quote on their phone. Choose a clear price-list photo, or paste prices.
Check the matched item and rate, then fill the quote.
Use one item at a time if helpful. Review delivery and the total, then send.
scenes.text: Suppliers can quote on their phone. Choose a clear price-list photo, or paste prices. Check the matched item and rate, then fill the quote. Use one item at a time if helpful. Review delivery and the total, then send.

scenes.title: Choose a supplier
phrases: Back in Purchases, compare the complete offers.
Check coverage, tax, delivery charges and dates.
Here, the totals are four hundred and four hundred forty rupees.
Choose the suitable supplier and confirm your decision.

scenes.title: Check what arrived
phrases: Now check what actually arrives.
We ordered ten kilos, but received nine.
Enter received quantities and check the invoice.
Record the missing kilo and forty rupees in credit still owed, then save.
